OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: disasterNumber
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: Sequentially assigned number used to designate an event or incident declared as a disaster. For more information on the disaster process visit https://www.fema.gov/disasters/how-declared

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: incidentType
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: Type of incident such as fire or flood. The incident type will affect the types of assistance available. For more information on incident types, please visit: https://www.fema.gov

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: state
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: The name of a U.S. state or territory

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: county
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: The name of a U.S. county, parish, borough, independent city or other political subdivision of a U.S. state or territory

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: applicantName
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: Name of the entity requesting Public Assistance grant funding. (Eligible Public Assistance applicants are sub-grantees)

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: educationApplicant
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: Denotes whether the applicant's primary function is educational; derived field based on suite of keywords in applicant name

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: numberOfProjects
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: Number of funded Project Worksheets associated with the applicant under the specified declaration

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: federalObligatedAmount
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: The Public Assistance grant funding available in dollars to the grantee (State), for sub-grantee approved Project Worksheets.

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: lastRefresh
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: Date the record was last updated in the API data store

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: hash
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: MD5 Hash of the fields and values of the record

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: id
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: Unique ID assigned to the record
